title: Passage 3  Jack's Birthday Party
subtitle: 考点：一般过去时
passage: Last Saturday was Jack's thirteenth birthday. His mother made a big cake for him in the morning. At two o'clock in the afternoon, ten friends came to his house. They sang "Happy Birthday" and gave him many presents.

Jack got a new football, two books and a pen. He was very happy and said "Thank you" to everyone. Then they ate the cake and played games in the garden. The party ended at five, but Jack remembered the day for a long time.
vocab: present 礼物 · sang 唱（过去式）· garden 花园 · remember 记得 · end 结束 · everyone 每个人

questions.stem: When was Jack's birthday party?
questions.why: 原文第一句：Last Saturday was Jack's thirteenth birthday.

questions.stem: How many friends came to Jack's house?
questions.why: 原文：ten friends came to his house.

questions.stem: What did Jack NOT get?
questions.why: 原文：Jack got a new football, two books and a pen. 没有提到自行车。

questions.stem: What did they do in the garden?
questions.why: 原文：they ate the cake and played games in the garden.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: Jack's mother bought a cake for him.
questions.why: 原文是 His mother made a big cake（做的，不是买的）。

questions.stem: The friends came to his house at two o'clock.
questions.why: 原文：At two o'clock in the afternoon, ten friends came.

questions.stem: Jack was sad at the party.
questions.why: 原文：He was very happy（很开心）。

questions.stem: The party ended at six.
questions.why: 原文：The party ended at five.

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: Jack's mother made a big cake ____ him.
questions.why: make sth. for sb. 为某人做某物。

questions.stem: ____ two o'clock, ten friends came to his house.
questions.why: 具体钟点前用 at（句首大写）。

questions.stem: They sang "Happy Birthday" ____ gave him many presents.
questions.why: 并列两个动作 sang 和 gave，用 and。

questions.stem: Jack said "Thank you" ____ everyone.
questions.why: say sth. to sb. 对某人说。

questions.stem: They played games ____ the garden.
questions.why: in the garden 在花园里。

questions.stem: The party ended at five, ____ Jack remembered the day.
questions.why: 前后转折（聚会结束了，但 Jack 还记得），用 but。

sections.title: 四、用动词的适当形式填空

questions.stem: Last night my mother ____ a delicious dinner.
questions.why: Last night 表示过去，用一般过去时；make 的过去式是 made。

questions.stem: Tom ____ to school late yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday 表示过去；come 的过去式是 came。

questions.stem: My uncle ____ me a nice pen on my birthday.
questions.why: 过去的事（原文也是 gave him many presents）；give 的过去式是 gave。

questions.stem: I ____ a letter from my pen friend last week.
questions.why: last week 表示过去；get 的过去式是 got。

questions.stem: We ____ noodles for lunch yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday 表示过去；eat 的过去式是 ate。

questions.stem: She ____ "Hello" to us and smiled.
questions.why: 和 smiled 一样用过去时；say 的过去式是 said。
